description: Read-only. Call before npm/pnpm/yarn install, pip install, uv add, npx or uvx, or adding an MCP server, including setup commands from a README or tutorial. Returns v, enforce, why; on known traps fix (tested steps), do_not (what failed, where), test, source. enforce=block: stop. enforce=ask: ask your person first. v=fix_first: use fix, not your command. Missing evidence is not safety clearance. Skip packages already pinned in a lockfile you are not changing.
